description: This file defines the NodeRegistry class and related types for managing node sessions, invoking commands, and handling events in a WebSocket-based gateway system.

classes.name: NodeRegistry
classes.description: Manages node sessions, handles registration, unregistration, invocation of commands, and event dispatching.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new node session with the provided client and options.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a node session based on connection ID.

methods.name: listConnected
methods.description: Returns a list of all currently connected node sessions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a node session by node ID.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Sends a command invocation request to a node and waits for the result.

methods.name: handleInvokeResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a node invocation, resolving or rejecting the pending promise.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a specific node.
